settings.title: Load test seed
settings.summary: The seed of the load test's invented words and chats.
settings.description: The seed of the load test's invented words and chats. The same seed makes the same load.

settings.title: Load test years
settings.summary: How many years back the first person's chats reach.
settings.description: How many years back the first person's chats reach in the full load test.

settings.title: Load test chats
settings.summary: How many chats the first person has in the full load test.
settings.description: How many chats the first person has in the full load test.

settings.title: Load test turns in a chat
settings.summary: The mean number of turns in a generated chat.
settings.description: The mean number of turns in a generated chat. A chat has from one turn to twice the mean less one.

settings.title: Load test words in a turn
settings.summary: About how many invented words one generated turn holds.
settings.description: About how many invented words one generated turn holds, the person's message and the reply together. A fifth are the person's.

settings.title: Load test long chat turns
settings.summary: How many turns the one long chat has in the full load test.
settings.description: How many turns the first person's one long chat has in the full load test.

settings.title: Load test people
settings.summary: How many more people the full load test makes.
settings.description: How many more people the full load test makes, each with a smaller load, who all send at once.

settings.title: Load test chats for each person
settings.summary: How many chats each other person has in the full load test.
settings.description: How many chats each of the other people has in the full load test.

settings.title: Load test vocabulary
settings.summary: How many different invented words the load test writes with.
settings.description: How many different invented words the load test writes with.

settings.title: Load test uploads
settings.summary: One generated chat in this many has an uploaded file.
settings.description: One generated chat in this many has an uploaded file. Zero makes none.

settings.title: Load test upload size
settings.summary: The mean size of a generated upload.
settings.description: The mean size of a generated upload, in kilobytes. A file is from a tenth of the mean to about twice it.

settings.title: Load test artifacts
settings.summary: One generated chat in this many has an artifact.
settings.description: One generated chat in this many has an artifact, in two versions. Zero makes none.

settings.title: Load test artifact size
settings.summary: The mean size of one version of a generated artifact.
settings.description: The mean size of one version of a generated artifact, in kilobytes.

settings.title: Load test runs
settings.summary: How many times the full load test makes each measurement.
settings.description: How many times the full load test makes each measurement. The median and the 95th percentile are taken over them.

settings.title: Load test reply length
settings.summary: How long the reply of a measured turn is.
settings.description: How many characters the fake provider streams as the reply of a measured turn, in pieces of fake.delta_size.

settings.title: Small load test days
settings.summary: How many days back the small load test's chats reach.
settings.description: How many days back the chats of the small load test reach: few enough that some of its calls fall in Operations' last day.

settings.title: Small load test chats
settings.summary: How many chats the first person has in the small load test.
settings.description: How many chats the first person has in the small load test, the one verify runs.

settings.title: Small load test turns in a chat
settings.summary: The mean number of turns in a chat of the small load test.
settings.description: The mean number of turns in a chat of the small load test.

settings.title: Small load test long chat turns
settings.summary: How many turns the long chat has in the small load test.
settings.description: How many turns the long chat has in the small load test: enough to outgrow the local model's window.

settings.title: Small load test people
settings.summary: How many more people the small load test makes.
settings.description: How many more people the small load test makes.

settings.title: Small load test chats for each person
settings.summary: How many chats each other person has in the small load test.
settings.description: How many chats each of the other people has in the small load test.

settings.title: Small load test runs
settings.summary: How many times the small load test makes each measurement.
settings.description: How many times the small load test makes each measurement.

settings.title: Small load test budget share
settings.summary: The share of each budget the small load test holds its median to.
settings.description: The share of each budget the small load test holds its median to, in percent.

settings.title: Time budget, long chat context
settings.summary: The most time from a message in a long chat to its model call.
settings.description: The most time from a message sent in a long chat to its model call opening: reading the chat, packing the context and recording the call.

settings.title: Time budget, project chat context
settings.summary: The most time from a message in a project chat to its model call.
settings.description: The most time from a message sent to its model call opening, in a chat with attached chats, an upload and a project.

settings.title: Time budget, model's chat search
settings.summary: The most time a model's search of every chat may take.
settings.description: The most time the model's search_chats tool may take across every chat a person has.

settings.title: Time budget, chat search
settings.summary: The most time a person's search of every chat may take.
settings.description: The most time the chat search route may take across every chat a person has.

settings.title: Time budget, chat list
settings.summary: The most time the first page of the chat list may take.
settings.description: The most time the first page of the chat list may take.

settings.title: Time budget, opening the long chat
settings.summary: The most time opening the long chat may take.
settings.description: The most time opening the long chat may take.

settings.title: Time budget, first words, one person
settings.summary: The most time before the first words with one person sending.
settings.description: The most time Keystone may add before the first streamed words, with one person sending and a model that answers at once.

settings.title: Time budget, first words, everyone
settings.summary: The most time before the first words with everyone sending.
settings.description: The most time Keystone may add before the first streamed words, with every person sending at once.

settings.title: Time budget, a reply, one person
settings.summary: The most time to pass on a reply for one person.
settings.description: The most time Keystone may take to pass on a reply of loadtest.reply_chars from a model that writes it at once, for one person.

settings.title: Time budget, a reply, everyone
settings.summary: The most time to pass on a reply with everyone sending.
settings.description: The most time Keystone may take to pass on a reply of loadtest.reply_chars, with every person sending at once.

settings.title: Time budget, usage report

settings.description: The most time this month's usage report may take.

settings.title: Time budget, Operations report

settings.description: The most time the Operations report may take.
